title: Package Sus Detector results
description: One item per checked package, plus a final summary item (recordType = summary).

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: 'package' for a package result, 'summary' for the final run summary.

name.title: Package name
name.description: Package name as checked (PyPI names normalised per PEP 503).

requestedVersion.title: Requested version
requestedVersion.description: Exact version requested, or null when the latest release was checked.

requestedRange.title: Requested range
requestedRange.description: Original version range (e.g. ^4.17.0) when it could not be pinned to one version; the latest release was checked.

resolvedVersion.title: Checked version
resolvedVersion.description: The version that vulnerability and licence data refer to.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: ok = no notable signals; caution = some risk signals worth reviewing (or known high/critical vulnerabilities, deprecation); suspicious = strong combination of risk signals or listed in the OSV malicious-packages feed; not_found = name not registered (possible hallucinated name); error = registry lookup failed (not charged).

riskScore.title: Risk score
riskScore.description: 0-100 heuristic score from summed risk signals. Higher means more signals; it is not a probability of malice.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One-line human-readable explanation of the top signals.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Machine-readable risk signals: [{code, severity (info|low|medium|high), points, message}] sorted by points.

registry.title: Registry facts
registry.description: exists, firstPublishedAt, ageDays, latestVersion, latestReleaseAt, daysSinceLastRelease, stale, versionCount, maintainerCount, weeklyDownloads, deprecated, deprecationMessage, installTimeCode, repositoryUrl.

license.title: Licence
license.description: spdx, category (permissive / weak-copyleft / strong-copyleft / network-copyleft / proprietary / unknown), note and compatibility hint relative to your project licence type.

vulnerabilities.title: Vulnerabilities (OSV)
vulnerabilities.description: count, maxSeverity (none/low/medium/high/critical/unknown), maxCvss, ids, top, fixedVersions, highestFixedVersion, knownMalicious, maliciousIds for the checked version.

depsDev.title: deps.dev
depsDev.description: Licences, advisory count, project status, provenance flag, source project and optional OpenSSF Scorecard.

endOfLife.title: End of life
endOfLife.description: endoflife.date release-line status when the package is tracked there: product, cycle, isEol, eolFrom.

typosquat.title: Typosquat check
typosquat.description: suspected, isPopular, matches [{popular, rank, type (edit_distance|separator_variant|combo), distance}] against the bundled top-5000 popular names for the ecosystem.

slopsquat.title: Slopsquat signal
slopsquat.description: signal (none|low|medium|high), plausibleHallucinatedName, basis. Based on name not registered, or very new + near-zero usage + AI-plausible name.

dataQuality.title: Data quality
dataQuality.description: complete, or partial when some upstream sources failed (see errors).

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Non-fatal upstream errors for this package.

totalChecked.title: Total checked (summary)
totalChecked.description: Summary item only: number of packages checked.

verdictCounts.title: Verdict counts (summary)
verdictCounts.description: Summary item only: counts per verdict.

overall.title: Overall (summary)
overall.description: Summary item only: worst verdict class in the run (ok, caution, suspicious, not_found, incomplete).

worstOffenders.title: Worst offenders (summary)
worstOffenders.description: Summary item only: up to 5 highest-scoring packages.

gate.title: CI gate (summary)
gate.description: Summary item only: failOn, passed, exitCode (0 or 1), failingCount, failing packages, incomplete (lookup errors) and complete (false when some packages were not checked).

markdown.title: Markdown report (summary)
markdown.description: Summary item only: report ready to paste into a pull-request comment or GitHub step summary.

overview.title: Verdicts
overview.description: One row per package, worst signals visible at a glance.
